transcript:
Painter (Ramesh): Namaste sir, main painting ka kaam karta hoon.
Homeowner (Anil): Haan batao, poora ghar paint karna hai. 3BHK hai, Flat 302, Green Glen Layout, Bellandur, Bengaluru.
Painter: Poora ghar, andar bahar se, 60,000 rupees mein kar denge. Material alag se aapka.
Homeowner: Theek hai. Lekin kaam khatam hone par hi paisa milega, advance nahi.
Painter: Chalega. 10 din mein poora ho jayega.
Homeowner: Har room ki photo bhejna — kaam se pehle aur baad mein dono.
Painter: Haan bhej dunga. Address wahi hona chahiye jo aapne diya hai.
Homeowner: Haan. Kaam adhoora chhoda to paisa nahi milega.
Painter: Theek hai sir, kal se shuru.
